title: The keys on the nail
logline: The shack's keys hung on a nail inside the shack, 1994, the uncle's hand leaving them, the bait cooler, the counter with nothing on it yet, the window with the dock. Where the keys went after the sentence. The corkboard not yet on the wall.

panels.composition: Inside a bare bait shack: two keys on a ring hung on a nail in the wall, a broad man's hand just leaving them, an empty counter, a bait cooler, the window showing a dock, the wall where a corkboard will be, bare.
